whenToUse: A charity, foundation or community project that takes one-off and monthly donations.
Organisations that want to show what each gift buys and publish a transparency report.
avoidWhen: Associations organised around membership and events — use site-club-01.
Government or municipal offices — use site-public-01.
a11y: The gift builder total updates in an aria-live region.
Give the decorative shelf drawing an empty alt or aria-hidden and keep the itemised amounts as text.
